newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco jails 75 people for riots.
newsitem.headline: Morocco jails 75 people for riots.

text.p: A Moroccan court sentenced 75 people to four months in jail for involvement in riots in the northern city of Tangier where hundreds of youths attacked banks last June, the official MAP news agency reported on Sunday.
The riots erupted after opposition parties called for a 24-hour general strike that paralysed much of the country's economic activity.
The defendents were sentenced on Saturday, MAP said.
The rioters, most of them teenagers and children set fire to two banks in a poor district in Tangier to protest against the government's social policies.
